notes.note: A round-trip time in milliseconds; {ms} is the formatted number.
State of an upstream resolver the node has not asked yet.
State of an upstream resolver whose last exchange was answered.
State of an upstream resolver that failed, fewer than three times in a row.
State of an upstream resolver in back-off after three failures in a row: asked only when every other one is.
The round-trip times of an upstream in its tooltip: the last, the smoothed (EWMA), the median and the 99th percentile of the last minute, and how many answers those two cover.

segment.source: Last {last}, smoothed {ewma}; over the last minute median {p50}, 99th percentile {p99} ({answers} answers).

notes.note: The answered and failed exchanges with an upstream since the node's DNS role started, in its tooltip.
Short tag on the upstream resolver the next query of a rule goes to (the fastest healthy one).
Tooltip sentence on the upstream the next query goes to; one query in 16 probes another one.

segment.source: The next query goes here (one in 16 probes another upstream).
segment.target: Nästa fråga går hit (en av 16 provar en annan uppströmsserver).

notes.note: The last failure of an upstream in its tooltip; {time} is when, {error} the server's English detail.
The rule column of the default forwarder from the configuration file ([dns] forwarders).
The rule column for the name servers of a stub zone; {zone} is the zone's name.
Heading of the section of a node's DNS settings that lists the upstream resolvers with their response times.
Explanation under the heading of the upstreams section.

segment.source: Round-trip times and states on this node since its DNS role started; the median and the 99th percentile cover the last minute. Each rule sends a query to its fastest healthy upstream, marked Next; one query in 16 probes another so that their times stay current.
segment.target: Svarstider och tillstånd på den här noden sedan dess DNS-roll startade; medianen och 99:e percentilen gäller senaste minuten. Varje regel skickar en fråga till sin snabbaste friska uppströmsserver, märkt Nästa; en fråga av 16 provar en annan så att deras tider hålls aktuella.

notes.note: Link from the upstreams section to the forwarding rules page.
